1.

O Thou King of glory, Lord Jesus Christ, Thou “the First and the Last;” Thou, who sufferest no change nor alteration, As we by years and seasons, Praise be to Thee, Heartily! Soon shall every tongue Only Thy name sing in praise.

2.

Shepherd with the holy, precious, deep wounds, Thou who gavest Thy life for the sheep, Thou art meek and patient, mighty in the weak, May our song of praise please Thee! Thine own work In us strengthen! We Thy name invoke, Before Thee fall down.

3.

Thou art one with the Father, the Ruler on the throne, God’s chosen, the Son of Man. Thou shalt soon reign over all the world As the great Victor; All for Thee Bow itself, We Thee, Lord, honour And to Thee praise bring home.
